name: autoresearch-train
description: Run the mirror's train.py on the A4000 as a sandman GPU job (host home mounted once; uv venv from the host cache)

cmd:
{ echo '--- /sandman/volumes ---'; ls -la /sandman/volumes/; echo '--- home ---'; ls -la /sandman/volumes/home/ | head -20; echo '--- home/.cache ---'; ls -la /sandman/volumes/home/.cache/ 2>&1 | head -12; echo '--- home/.cache/autoresearch ---'; ls -la /sandman/volumes/home/.cache/autoresearch/ 2>&1 | head -12; echo '--- repo ---'; ls /sandman/volumes/home/Documents/autoresearch 2>&1 | head -5; } > "$OUT/diag.txt" 2>&1
cat "$OUT/diag.txt"
